name: ZEvent MCP Bridge
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) bridge for AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, Antigravity) to inspect, query, edit, and manage ZEventStudio event flowcharts, project files, SARC archives, and code in real time.
author: ZEvent Studio Team

commands.title: Start Local API Server
commands.description: Starts the local HTTP bridge server on port 31415

commands.title: Copy MCP Configuration
commands.description: Copies client JSON configuration for Claude Desktop or Cursor

tools.name: zevent_get_status
tools.description: Get current status, opened project, active document tab, and graph summary of ZEventStudio

tools.name: zevent_get_project
tools.description: Get opened project path, file tree summary, open tabs, and project details

tools.name: zevent_list_files
tools.description: Query and list all files and SARC archives in the opened project (supports filtering, recursive traversal, and SARC subfile extraction)

path.description: Subdirectory path or SARC file path to list (defaults to project root)

recursive.description: Recursively list all subdirectories and nested SARCs (default: true)

include_sarc.description: Whether to unpack and list virtual files inside SARC/Yaz0 archives (default: true)

limit.description: Maximum number of file entries to return (default: 2000)

tools.name: zevent_read_file
tools.description: Read the source code or formatted text representation of any file in the opened project or inside SARC archives (automatically decompiles BFEVFL to JSON graph, BYML/AAMP/MSBT to YAML/MSYT, and reads plain text or active in-memory editor tabs)

path.description: Target file path (can be absolute physical path, relative path in project, or SARC path like 'SARC:path.sbeventpack//Event/Demo.bfevfl')

format.description: Format mode: 'code' (default, parses to editable code/YAML/JSON) or 'raw' (UTF-8 text)

tools.name: zevent_write_file
tools.description: Write, modify, or create a file or code in the opened project or inside SARC archives (automatically recompiles JSON graphs to BFEVFL, YAML to BYML/AAMP/MSBT, compresses with Yaz0 if needed, writes to disk or SARC pack, and live-synchronizes any open tabs in ZEventStudio)

path.description: Target file path (can be physical file or SARC virtual path like 'SARC:path.sbeventpack//Event/Demo.bfevfl')

content.description: Source code, JSON graph, YAML, or text content to write

format.description: Format override. If omitted, auto-detected from path extension

tools.name: zevent_delete_file
tools.description: Delete a physical file/directory or remove a virtual subfile from within a SARC archive, and close any corresponding open tabs in ZEventStudio

path.description: Path of physical file/directory or SARC virtual entry to delete

tools.name: zevent_rename_file
tools.description: Rename or move a physical file/directory or a subfile within a SARC archive, updating all open document tabs in ZEventStudio

old_path.description: Original file or SARC virtual entry path

new_name.description: New file name or new inner path

tools.name: zevent_create_directory
tools.description: Create a new directory recursively in the opened project

path.description: Directory path to create (relative to project root or absolute)

tools.name: zevent_search_code
tools.description: Search for text or keywords across all files and SARC archives in the opened project (returns matching files, line numbers, and code snippets)

query.description: Keyword or string to search for

file_pattern.description: Filter by file path or extension pattern, e.g. '.bfevfl' or 'Actor'

tools.name: zevent_get_tabs
tools.description: Get all currently opened document tabs in ZEventStudio (with tab ID, title, file path, type, active status, and modification state)

tools.name: zevent_open_file
tools.description: Open a file or SARC entry into an active document tab in ZEventStudio UI (supports BFEVFL flowchart view and code editor view)

path.description: File path to open in editor tab

tools.name: zevent_save_file
tools.description: Save the currently active document tab or a specified document tab to disk or SARC archive

tab_id.description: Tab ID to save. If omitted, saves the currently active document

tools.name: zevent_close_file
tools.description: Close an opened document tab by tab ID or file path in ZEventStudio

path.description: File path of tab to close

tools.name: zevent_reload_project
tools.description: Rescan and refresh the current project file tree and Git version control status in ZEventStudio

tools.name: zevent_open_project
tools.description: Open and load a new project directory (Mod root) or SARC pack file (.sbeventpack, .sbactorpack, .pack) into ZEventStudio

path.description: Project directory path or pack file path to open

tools.name: zevent_get_graph
tools.description: Get the complete event flowchart graph (nodes, edges, actors, properties) for the active document

tools.name: zevent_add_node
tools.description: Add a new node (Action, Query, Switch, Fork, Join, SubFlow, EntryPoint, Comment) to the active flowchart

tools.name: zevent_connect_nodes
tools.description: Connect two nodes with a directed edge in the active flowchart

tools.name: zevent_update_node
tools.description: Update properties, title, or actor of an existing node in the active flowchart

tools.name: zevent_delete_node
tools.description: Delete a node and its connected edges from the active flowchart

tools.name: zevent_auto_layout
tools.description: Automatically calculate Sugiyama hierarchical layout for the active flowchart and fit view

tools.name: zevent_toast
tools.description: Display a popup toast notification inside the ZEventStudio UI
